fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects Azure Hybrid Connection Manager services querying the Azure service bus service
fields.name: DNS HybridConnectionManager Service Bus
fields.query: event.category="dns" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (event.dns.request contains "servicebus.windows.net" and src.process.image.path contains "HybridConnectionManager"))
